root_cause.text: In erofs file-backed mounts, the completion handler `erofs_fileio_ki_complete` incorrectly treats short reads (e.g., interrupted by SIGKILL) as successful by zero-filling the remaining bio and marking all folios as uptodate, allowing potentially invalid data to be used.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `vfs_iocb_iter_read()` can return fewer bytes than requested when interrupted by SIGKILL, and the callback then sets all folios in the bio as uptodate via `erofs_fileio_ki_complete`. The patch fixes this by replacing the zero-fill logic with `ret = -EIO` for short reads, so the bio is treated as failed and the uptodate flag is not set incorrectly. The diff shows the removal of `bio_advance(&rq->bio, ret); zero_fill_bio(&rq->bio);` and addition of `ret = -EIO;` when `ret != rq->bio.bi_iter.bi_size`.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the vulnerability by converting the short I/O completion handling from zero-filling the bio (which allowed invalid data to be used) to returning an error (-EIO), thus fixing the root cause.

candidates.rationale: This condition incorrectly treats short reads (ret >=0 but not full size) as a non-error, allowing the zero-fill path to be taken instead of returning an error.
Advances the bio iterator past the actually read portion, leaving the bio representing only the unfilled part to be zero-filled.
Zero-fills the remaining bio, making the short read appear fully successful and allowing potentially invalid zero-filled data to be used as valid folio content.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition allows short reads (non-negative but incomplete) to enter the zero-fill path, preventing the I/O error from being propagated.
Advances the bio iterator past the actually read portion, so zero_fill_bio only fills the unfilled part, making the short read appear to have read the full requested size.
Zero-fills the remaining bio data, marking all folios as uptodate, thus allowing potentially invalid zero-filled data to be used as valid content.
